convert_quaternion_to_rotation_matrix: convert a batch of quaternions to 3x3 rotation matrices using the quaternion_to_rotation_matrix function
compute_wigner_d_l2_einsum: compute l=2 Wigner D matrices from quaternions using the quaternion_to_wigner_d_l2_einsum tensor contraction kernel
compute_wigner_d_matmul_l3_l4: compute l=3 or l=4 Wigner D matrices from quaternions using the quaternion_to_wigner_d_matmul polynomial coefficient approach
compute_batched_wigner_d_l3_l4: compute l=3 and l=4 Wigner D matrices together using the quaternion_to_wigner_d_l3l4_batched single matmul kernel
initialize_custom_kernel_module: initialize a CustomKernelModule to load and hold precomputed Wigner D coefficient tensors as PyTorch nn.Module buffers
